title: The delete class matches removed or removal of a flag anywhere before the word content, kb or history in the same question, so a design question is made blocking
goal: a gate asking whether the removed flag is content-addressed is classed by its other words, while the old rows are removed from kb history stays delete

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_authority as b; bad=[q for q in ("Is the removed flag content-addressed?","Is removal of the flag content-addressed?") if b.class_reasons({"touches":[]},{"id":"g1","question":q,"options":["one","two"]})[0]=="delete"]; print("delete:",bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
